Review the shared refresh policy

Concurrent requests share one refresh and each retries once. Review both changed files, choose the rollout audience, then record the review result.

Review checklist

A failed refresh must fail every waiting request without retrying with an expired token.

Five concurrent requests

One refresh completes before all five requests retry. A second failure returns to the caller.

Canary clients

Enable shared refresh for the canary group before the wider rollout.

All clients

Enable shared refresh for every web client in this release.

Changed files

+++ b/client/session.py
@@ -1,4 +1,5 @@
 async def recover(request):
-    token = await refresh()
+    token = await shared_refresh()
     response = await request.retry(token)
+    response.raise_for_status()
     return response
